videos.title: Sailboats and Rowboats on a Quiet Mountain Lake | Calming Video for Kids & Toddlers
videos.scenario: A few sailboats and rowboats drift slowly across flat, misty water while the sun comes up behind the mountains.
videos.safety_notes: Everyone on board wears a life jacket; slow speed only; no wakes, no crowding, no capsizing.

videos.title: Slow Canal Boats Through the Countryside | Relaxing Vehicles for Toddlers
videos.setting: green countryside canal in the afternoon
videos.scenario: Narrowboats and barges glide at walking pace past meadows, ducks, and stone bridges.
videos.safety_notes: Walking-pace speed only; boats pass at a safe distance; locks shown only with calm, orderly operation.

videos.title: Airplanes Gliding Above the Sunset Clouds | Calm Sleepy Video for Kids
videos.setting: high altitude at sunset above the clouds
videos.scenario: Airliners cruise smoothly above soft pink clouds; cabin-window views of wing and sky.
videos.safety_notes: Cruise flight only; no turbulence, no emergency, no low flying near buildings.

videos.title: Little Planes at the Countryside Airfield | Gentle Aeroplane Video for Toddlers
videos.setting: small grass airfield on a sunny summer day
videos.scenario: Small propeller planes taxi slowly, take off gently, and land softly on a grass strip.
videos.safety_notes: Normal takeoffs and landings only; clear runway; no aerobatics, no near-misses, no crosswind drama.

videos.title: Cars on a Quiet Autumn Country Road | Calming Cars for Kids
videos.setting: country road lined with autumn trees
videos.scenario: A few cars drive slowly along a leaf-covered road, stopping politely at a crossing.
videos.safety_notes: Under the speed limit; seatbelts visible where people are shown; stops at crossings; no racing, no tailgating.

videos.title: Slow Cars in a Cozy Snowy Village | Winter Calm Video for Toddlers
videos.setting: small village in gentle snowfall at dusk
videos.scenario: Cars crawl carefully through snowy streets under warm lights; a snowplow clears a lane slowly.
videos.safety_notes: Very slow speed in snow; large gaps between cars; no skidding or getting stuck.

videos.title: A Scenic Mountain Train in Spring | Relaxing Train Video for Kids
videos.scenario: A passenger train rolls slowly through green valleys, tunnels, and over a stone viaduct.
videos.safety_notes: Moderate speed; crossings with barriers down and no one on the tracks; no people near rails.

videos.title: Rainy Day Trains at a Cozy Station | Quiet Train Video for Toddlers
videos.setting: small town station on a rainy evening
videos.scenario: Trains pull in and out of a sleepy station while rain taps the roof; passengers wait behind the yellow line.
videos.safety_notes: Platform passengers stay behind the line; trains arrive and depart slowly; no one running or crossing tracks.
videos.music_mood: rainy-day soft jazz piano, brushes only

videos.title: Hot Air Balloons Floating at Sunrise | Calm Balloon Video for Kids & Toddlers
videos.scenario: Colorful balloons inflate and drift lazily over fields and rivers in light winds.
videos.safety_notes: Light winds only; balloons keep clear of power lines and each other; baskets shown upright with calm operation.
videos.music_mood: airy synth pads and gentle harp

videos.title: Helicopters Gliding Over Green Hills and Blue Sea | Calming Video for Toddlers
videos.setting: coastal hills in clear daytime weather
videos.scenario: Helicopters fly smoothly along the coast, hover gently, and land on a marked helipad.
videos.safety_notes: Tourism/transport flights only; no rescue drama or military; land on marked helipads; safe altitude.
